title: Ship generic local Figma MCP foundation
description: Turn the poster-specific Codex bridge into an open-source local Figma MCP foundation while preserving poster tools. Add bounded document/selection inspection, generic node creation and updates, packaging docs, ADR, CI, and verification.

title: Run Figma Desktop end-to-end smoke test
description: Import manifest.json in Figma Desktop, start Figma Local MCP, call get_document/create_nodes/update_nodes from Codex against a disposable file, and verify editable output plus error recovery.

title: Publish public repository and v0.1 release
description: After confirming GitHub owner/repository name, add the remote, push main, enable branch protection/security reporting, and create a traceable v0.1 release.
